description: CSIC and PIRAGUA partners derived streamflow and groundwater indicators from long observed series across the Pyrenees in Spain, France and Andorra. The article reports 93 river stations, 29 wells and 19 indicators of mean, high and low flow, with streamflow records extending within 1950–2019. The named Digital.CSIC landing currently lists eight items: seven compressed packages for trends, means, maps and station reports, plus a README. Its rights link specifies Open Data Commons ODbL 1.0 and open access, so reuse is free with attribution and share-alike database terms. Coverage is monitored locations, not every river reach; groundwater records are shorter and often discontinuous. Trend estimates and uneven gauge periods limit extrapolation to unmonitored catchments; archive contents were not inspected. A reviewer-assessed use is checking water-resource and flood-regime assumptions in Pyrenean adaptation simulations. model-wflow is a related hydrological model, but no direct forcing conversion was tested. No ZIP, README or article PDF was downloaded.
